name: Smith Machine Sumo Squat
steps: Rest the bar across your upper back with your feet wide, slightly ahead of the rails and your toes turned comfortably outward.
Release the hooks, brace your trunk and bend your hips and knees, tracking your knees over your toes.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor while keeping your heels grounded.
Drive forcefully through your midfoot and heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes and inner thighs.
tips: Keep your knees tracking directly over your angled toes instead of letting them collapse inward.
Keep your torso tall throughout the squat rather than pitching forward.
